name: obsidian-tabstrip
description: Group tabs into named, colored, collapsible groups like browser tab groups, with an optional vertical tab strip.

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.spike:s1:build: tsc -p spikes/s1-chip/plugin/tsconfig.json && tsc -p spikes/s1-chip/tsconfig.json && node spikes/s1-chip/build.mjs
scripts.spike:s1: npm run spike:s1:build && node scripts/e2e.mjs --config spikes/s1-chip/wdio.conf.mts
scripts.spike:s1:matrix: npm run spike:s1:build && node scripts/e2e.mjs --matrix --config spikes/s1-chip/wdio.conf.mts
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: huzibo-yyds
